Ordinary profit was ¥200 million (up 48.3% year on year), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥142 million (up 251.1%), including special gains of ¥21 million from the sale of investment securities. entries.982dfe5f40087cb6: This is the Group's business of planning, developing, researching and selling cosmetics for hair salons, beauty salons, nail salons, eyelash salons, beauty clinics and others (the securities report calls these 'salons'), from product planning through research and development to sales. The securities report states that because this is the only segment in the business, it does not present segment-by-segment information. The products are described as containing sugars and minerals also found in body fluids, in a proprietary balance, with factors that cause skin and hair problems removed as far as possible. Sales take the form in which the consolidated subsidiary Adjuvant Cosme Japan Co., Ltd. sells products to salons, either through agents or directly, and the salons sell to consumers through counseling. The company also holds seminars and hands-on sessions for salons to convey product explanations and sales knowledge and skills. 2C Co., Ltd. delivers hair-growth products directly to consumers through EC, and ADJUVANT GLOBAL COMPANY LIMITED in Hong Kong sells products directly to salons and also carries out promotions aimed at general consumers. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,813 million (down 6.9% year on year), with domestic revenue of ¥3,654 million (95.8% of the total) and overseas revenue of ¥158 million (4.2% of the total). The number of salons with which the company did business during the period (the 'number of active salons' in the securities report) was 14,609, an increase of 1,943 from the same period last year. Products are handled in the following three categories, and revenue for each category is stated before deducting sales rebates not allocated to the categories. In addition, the securities report notes that 2C Co., Ltd. merged with Adjuvant Cosme Japan Co., Ltd. effective March 21, 2026. The company transitioned to a pure holding company structure effective September 21, 2021.
